text_blocks.snippet: Jardiance (empagliflozin) can cause common side effects like increased urination, urinary tract infections (UTIs), and genital yeast infections.
snippet_highlighted_words: increased urination, urinary tract infections (UTIs), and genital yeast infections

list.snippet: Increased urination: Frequent trips to the bathroom occur because the medication helps your kidneys remove extra sugar through your urine.
Urinary tract infections (UTIs): Burning, pain, urgency, or cloudy urine can happen because extra sugar in the urine attracts bacteria.
Genital yeast infections: Vaginal yeast infections in women (itching, burning, thick white discharge) and yeast infections around the penis in men (redness, itching, swelling) are common.
Increased thirst and dehydration: Loss of body fluids can lead to dizziness, lightheadedness, or dry mouth.

text_blocks.snippet: Seek immediate medical attention if you experience signs of these rare but dangerous complications:

list.snippet: Diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA): A life-threatening buildup of acid in the blood, even with normal blood sugar levels. Symptoms include nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, unusual fatigue, trouble breathing, and fruity-smelling breath.
Severe dehydration or kidney problems: Signs include a drastic drop in urine output, extreme dizziness, or confusion.

Serious genital or perineal infections: Necrotizing fasciitis (Fournier's gangrene) is a rare, severe bacterial infection of the tissue under the skin in the groin or perineal area, causing intense pain, redness, swelling, and fever.
Low blood sugar (Hypoglycemia): More likely if Jardiance is taken alongside other diabetes medications like insulin or sulfonylureas.
Lower limb amputations: A higher risk has been observed, particularly in patients with a history of foot ulcers, neuropathy, or peripheral vascular disease.
Serious allergic reactions: Hives or swelling of the face, lips, tongue, and throat.

text_blocks.snippet: You can read more about safety details on the Jardiance Official Site.
